title: Separable images of elements of filtered etale fibres
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I$ a small filtered category, $D:I\to\mathrm{CAlg}_A$ a diagram [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of etale $A$-algebras [def-weil-etale-morphism], and $B=\operatorname{colim}D$. Let $p$ be a prime of $A$, put $k=\kappa(p)$ and $C=k\otimes_A B$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Let $K$ be a field with a $k$-algebra structure and $f:C\to K$ a unital ring homomorphism satisfying $f(\lambda\otimes1)=\operatorname{algebraMap}_{k,K}(\lambda)$ for all $\lambda\in k$. Then for every $x\in C$, the element $f(x)$ is separable over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. No Noetherian or surjectivity hypothesis is required.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0AH1, proof; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0AH1

proof.text: Tensor symmetry and the elementwise tensor-colimit statement lift x to y∈C_i=κ(p)⊗_A D_i.
The scalar compatibility makes f a κ(p)-algebra homomorphism. Its composite g:C_i→K with the tensor coprojection is a κ(p)-algebra homomorphism. Its kernel P is prime because K is a field.

Base change makes C_i etale over κ(p). Its quotient by P is a finite separable field extension. Lean obtains Algebra.IsSeparable κ(p) (C_i/P) from the quotient instance in Mathlib.RingTheory.Etale.Field; this is the corresponding field factor in the etale-over-field decomposition.

Ideal.kerLiftAlg g is an injective κ(p)-algebra map from C_i/P into K. Apply IsSeparable.map to the separable element represented by y. The kernel lift sends this element to g(y)=f(x), giving the desired conclusion.
